note: One-sentence developer needs for the held-out set (v3 Part D). Written from the task, not from pattern metadata. Fresh claude -p processes turn each into a request; 5 per cataloged task, 1 per negative.

positives.jwt_create: A backend developer needs to give a user who just logged in a signed token that other services can verify and that stops working after a while.
positives.password_hash: A developer building sign-up and login needs to save users' passwords safely and later check whether a typed password is correct.
positives.paginate_query: A developer's API endpoint lists database records through SQLAlchemy and must return them one page at a time together with how many records exist in total.
positives.http_retry: A developer's service calls an unreliable external HTTP API that sometimes times out or returns server errors, so the call should be attempted again with growing pauses.
positives.env_config: A developer wants the application to read its settings, such as the database address, port and debug switch, from environment variables at startup, with defaults and rejecting bad values.
positives.token_bucket: A developer needs to stop any single client from making too many API requests in a short time and tell blocked clients when they can try again.
positives.csv_import: Staff upload a spreadsheet export of new users to an admin tool, and the developer must read it, check every row, and report which rows are wrong and why.

negatives: A developer must expose a FastAPI endpoint that accepts sign-up data, validates it and creates the user through a repository.
A developer needs to email users a link to reset their forgotten password.
A developer wants to make small thumbnails of photos users upload.
A developer needs to turn Markdown documents into HTML pages.
A developer wants a maintenance task to run automatically every night.
A developer needs the distance in kilometres between two GPS coordinates.
A developer must download very large files to disk while showing progress.
A developer needs to convert timestamps between users' time zones.
A developer wants to export a report as an Excel workbook with several sheets.
A developer wants to cache slow database lookups in Redis for a few minutes.
A developer is building a live chat that pushes messages to every connected browser.
A developer needs to check whether a credit card number is plausibly valid before charging it.
A developer wants to generate a QR code image for a ticket.
A developer wants the application's logs written as structured JSON lines.
A developer needs a worker that consumes jobs from a RabbitMQ queue.
